title: Lane briefs are built by a tool from the step file and the governing rulings' own words, then checked against the rulings store before the lane starts (EXPRESS)
why: Owner 13:37 CST Nov 13, relayed by the retrospective: "we need briefs to be improved then, greatly, that cna be a huge lift". Evidence: the 12:07 "close after merge" brief was stricter than the owner's Nov 9 words.
source: owner 13:37 CST Nov 13, via retrospective and coordinator 13:39 CST
note: EXPRESS, doing, lane brief-from-step (session_013NEJL3zemFrPdTzdnwhpVi, started 13:39 CST). (1) A tool builds each lane brief from its step file, with the governing rulings quoted in their own words and times from the rulings store, the files, the done-check and the failure classes. (2) A model-judged check reads the finished brief against the store before the lane starts and flags a dropped or narrowed ruling. The lane reads first, builds only the gap: past-ruling-on-send, brief-reads-owner-rulings (PR #2944), lane-brief-cites-grant (doing), lane-brief-template-gaps (PR #3237). Past rulings not checked by triage. Owner 14:05 CST: "case 2: that should be part of our brief fixes". An Opus marker (Round 3 of 3, Audit:, Fix check) must sit on the brief's first line; the brief template this lane builds puts it there (retrospective sent it to the coordinator for the lane). Source ruling own-r3-reviewer-sonnet-high. Owner faults 14:32 CST Nov 13 (via retro): brief template rulings come only from repo records (not the plan, see step plan-rulings-to-records); done-checks must be runnable by the lane. Folds brief-matches-rulings. Retro ranks this with step reviewer-mechanical-checks as the two that catch the most. Retro 14:34: a brief cites each ruling by its store id with the path (origin/roadmap:roadmap/rulings/<id>.json), and agents read it there. Replaces the withdrawn plan-rulings-to-records. Fact 17:04 CST Nov 13 (lane brief-from-step, session_013NEJL3zemFrPdTzdnwhpVi): steps carry no files or done-check field; the tool reads optional `done_check` and `ci_only`. Triage can add them to a step on request; none exist today. Lane's read, unchecked by triage. Coordinator 20:08 CST Nov 13 (20:07): part 3 added from step brief-runs-touched-suite-whole: a builder brief names the whole file of each test suite the diff can break (lane gh-quota-budget's builder ran only selected test_merge classes and missed that FakeHost lacked the new seams). Built by this step's lane after #3261 lands.
